world: One image contains five equal portrait 9:16 panels, ordered left to right across the top row, then left to right across the bottom row; the bottom-right grid space stays blank. Use narrow plain gutters without text or symbols. Kasun is a smooth, featureless red artist's mannequin of medium height and lean build; Anudi is a smooth, featureless blue mannequin of average height and slender build. Props and surroundings are painted realistically. Fine drizzle, rain-wet asphalt and concrete, soft overcast morning light and faint amber shop illumination share one naturalistic, slightly desaturated grade. Anudi holds an open navy umbrella in her left hand and carries a structured tan handbag on her right shoulder, with brass-coloured fittings and an open exterior pocket. The orange smartphone has a transparent case and three prominent rear camera circles. The parked three-wheeler has muted dark-green bodywork, a black canopy and a dull metal rear wheel. Nothing bears readable lettering.
geography: The walking route runs across the image from left to right, with every camera remaining on the road side of that axis and looking toward the pavement and buildings. The three-wheeler occupies the left end of a compact vending bay beneath a blue awning; its rear wheel stands beside the open kerb drain and the phone's landing patch. Beyond the vehicle, the narrow concrete pavement continues right alongside a weathered pale boundary wall toward recessed shop shutters. Anudi passes the vehicle and continues right; Kasun starts beside it and follows her rightward. The blue awning remains on frame left as it recedes, while the same boundary wall becomes more prominent toward frame right. The drain follows the lower edge of this connected route.
conflicts: Shot 3 requests both a mid-thigh-up medium frame and the phone beside Kasun's foot in the opening picture. The panel prioritizes the foot-and-phone opening, using a downward lower-chest-to-ground detail composition.
The location description combines early-morning daylight with evening shop light. The board uses overcast morning daylight with amber shop practicals switched on.
The requested featureless mannequin treatment prevents visible articulation of Kasun's spoken line. His speaking state is retained in shot 4 metadata without drawn dialogue or facial detail.
The plan specifies both 24mm and 50mm; this panel uses the explicit 24mm lens specification.

The mid-thigh-up framing would exclude the opening phone and foot. This panel instead includes the lower chest through the pavement, prioritizing the specified curb-height viewpoint and opening composition over the slightly downward angle.
The plan specifies a shoe, but the approved mannequin reference has uncovered mannequin feet; that appearance is retained.
The new shot plan specifies maroon three-wheeler bodywork, but the approved board and adjoining reference show dark green; retain dark green for continuity.

panels.camera: Standing eye height on the road side, looking across the route toward the vending bay; locked 28mm wide composition with full figures and deep focus.
panels.background: The three-wheeler and blue shop awning occupy frame left. The modest concrete frontage sits behind center, the weathered boundary wall continues toward frame right, and the kerb drain crosses the lower frame.
panels.picture: Kasun's red mannequin stands beside the three-wheeler on the left third, chest and head directed screen right in profile, with both hands resting low beside the body. Anudi's blue mannequin is mid-step just left of center, travelling across frame toward screen right with chest and head facing along the pavement. Her left hand grips the umbrella shaft, while her right hand holds the orange phone immediately outside the handbag pocket on her right side; the road beneath the pocket is unobstructed.

panels.zone: Vending bay, beside the three-wheeler's rear wheel
panels.camera: Low curb-height position beside the drain, remaining on the road side of the action axis and looking across the pavement; 24mm medium pickup-detail composition at f/4, cropped from Kasun's lower chest to the ground.
panels.background: Dark-green three-wheeler bodywork and its rear wheel occupy frame left. The open drain runs along lower left, wet concrete extends behind Kasun's legs, and the weathered boundary wall's base appears at upper right.
panels.picture: Kasun's red mannequin stands upright with its chest facing screen right, both feet planted and the right foot at lower center beside the orange phone. His right hand hangs open beside his right thigh, directly above the phone, while his left hand rests beside the opposite hip. The phone lies back-up on the pavement beside the curb line, its transparent case and three rear camera circles visible, with clear space between it and the drain.

panels.zone: Vending bay, beside the three-wheeler's rear wheel
panels.camera: On the road side of the established axis, just above Kasun's lowered right-hand height, looking slightly down across the pavement; tight portrait 9:16 insert with shallow focus.
panels.background: Soft dark-green three-wheeler bodywork and part of its rear wheel occupy frame left. The wet curb and open drain remain lower left, with rain-darkened concrete filling frame right.
panels.picture: Kasun's red mannequin right hand and a short length of forearm fill the insert with the phone, its dark screen facing upward toward the camera. His fingers support the underside while his thumb rests against the transparent case edge, leaving the orange rim visible. Rain droplets bead on the unlit glass, sharply defined against the softly blurred vehicle at frame left and wet pavement at frame right.

panels.zone: Walkway immediately ahead of the vending bay
panels.camera: Standing eye height, ahead and to Kasun's road-side right, looking diagonally back across his route; 35mm medium chest-up composition at f/2.8, preserving lateral rightward travel and a three-quarter view.
panels.background: The blue awning recedes at far frame left, with a small dark-green edge of the three-wheeler beneath it. The weathered boundary wall now fills center and right, while a narrow strip of the same open drain remains lower left.
panels.picture: Kasun's red mannequin is already in a rightward running pose, chest angled screen right and head directed farther along the pavement, past rather than toward the camera. His right elbow is bent with the orange phone upright and clearly visible at lower frame right, while his left arm is bent in a running counterpose. Leave space ahead of his upper body on frame right, with the distant blue awning retained at frame left.

panels.zone: Walkway ahead, beside the boundary wall
panels.camera: Standing eye height on the road side, square across the left-to-right action line; locked 50mm medium two-shot at f/2.8, wide enough to retain the umbrella and both hand positions.
panels.background: The blue awning is small at far frame left. The weathered pale boundary wall spans behind the gap between the figures, a recessed shutter appears at frame right, and the drain remains along the lower-left edge.
panels.picture: Anudi's blue mannequin stands at frame right with chest and head still facing screen right, her left hand gripping the open umbrella and her empty right hand hanging beside the handbag. Kasun's red mannequin enters from frame left in a shortened rightward step, chest and head directed toward Anudi. His right hand carries the orange phone slightly forward at waist height, his left arm remains bent beside his body, and a clear gap separates him from Anudi.
